items.title: Dutch take to the streets to support Palestinians
items.summary: Tens of thousands of people dressed in red thronged the streets of Amsterdam on Sunday to denounce ongoing violence against Palestinians in Gaza, carrying signs reading "Stop the Genocide". Organisers said some 20,000 people attended the "red line" protest, demanding that the Dutch government take action against Israel. "Stop sending weapons to Israel," one of the protesters, Steven Eisinger, a 33-year-old robotics engineer originally from the United States, told AFP,…

ai.sum: Some 20,000 people protested in Amsterdam demanding the Dutch government stop arms sales to Israel over Gaza.

items.title: Trump says he is highly unlikely to order Iran strikes if talks progress
items.summary: WASHINGTON/CAIRO, Nov 8 (Reuters) - US PresidentDonald Trump on Sunday said he was highly unlikely to order fresh attacks on Iran as long as talks to end the conflict progress, even as both countries reported that shipping had been hit in or near the Strait of Hormuz. "It depends on whether or not they sign a very strong agreement," Trump told CNN in a phone interview. "The answer is, highly unlikely it's going to be necessary."

ai.sum: Trump told CNN a fresh US strike on Iran is highly unlikely while talks progress, as both sides report shipping hits near Hormuz.
